description: End-of-turn sequence: 'First, if you scored 1 or more VP from a Secondary Mission card, discard that card — it is achieved. Then, you can discard one or more of your active Secondary Mission cards (gain 1CP).' A card you scored VP from this turn must therefore NEVER be offered for the discard-for-CP step, and Fixed Mission cards can never be discarded at all. Part 1 (real path, Fixed): Engage on All Fronts scores at end of turn and — being Fixed — stays in hand; its Discard button must be locked and the End Turn prompt must not open for it. Part 2 (real path, Tactical): a card that scores is discarded as achieved and no discard action is offered. Part 3 (backstop, synthetic): a Tactical card carrying a this-turn VP tally is refused by voluntary_discard while its unscored neighbour is still discardable through the real dialog.

steps.script:
var mgr = SecondaryMissionManager
var p = GameState.get_active_player()
# Own the setup end-to-end: this scenario is about the discard gate, so it
# builds the hand itself rather than depending on whatever the fixture's
# Command-phase entry left in the deck (iss063b covers that bootstrap).
if not mgr.is_initialized(p):
	mgr.setup_tactical_deck(p)
var st = mgr._player_state[str(p)]
st["active"].insert(0, mgr._create_active_mission(SecondaryMissionData.get_mission_by_id("no_prisoners")))
st["active"][0]["vp_scored"] = 3
st["active"][0]["vp_scored_this_turn"] = 3
return str(mgr.can_voluntarily_discard(p, 0))
steps.equals: { "allowed": false, "reason": "Already scored 3 VP this turn — an achieved card cannot be discarded for CP" }
